description: Several large plastic blocks sit on the green bedspread in front, including a blue base piece, red pieces, a yellow block, and a small green block. Both hands reach forward; the right hand picks up and presses a red block onto the blue base while the left hand brings another red piece in, then the hands lift and rotate the yellow block as a two-hand object and set it down onto the growing stack before the left hand reaches back toward the green piece.
